title: SimpMC
description: Build, explore, and battle with players from around the world on SimpMC.
body:
# Welcome to SimpMC

**SimpMC** is a Minecraft server offering multiple gameplay experiences, including **Pure Survival**, **Enhanced Survival**, and **UHC**. Whether you enjoy building large projects, exploring the world, or competing against other players, you'll find a place here.

**Server IP:** `simpmc.org`
**Documentation:** [https://doc.simpmc.org](https://doc.simpmc.org)

---

## Survival

Our survival servers are designed for different playstyles.

### Pure Survival

Experience Minecraft in its classic form. Gather resources, build your base, explore the world, and survive with other players in a simple and community-driven environment.

### Enhanced Survival

Looking for something beyond vanilla gameplay? Enhanced Survival introduces additional features and mechanics while keeping the core survival experience intact, providing more progression paths and challenges.

---

## UHC

**Ultra Hardcore (UHC)** is a fast-paced PvP game mode where survival is everything.

Players compete in a shrinking world with limited resources and no natural health regeneration. Gather equipment, form strategies, and fight to become the last survivor.

![uhc](https://img.simpmc.org/file/1779898605021_uhc-1.png)

---

## Why SimpMC?

### Multiple Game Modes

From peaceful survival gameplay to competitive PvP events, SimpMC offers a variety of experiences for different types of players.

### Active Community

Play alongside other Minecraft enthusiasts, participate in events, and become part of a growing community.

### Stable Experience

Our goal is to provide a reliable and enjoyable server environment so you can focus on playing and having fun.

---

## Join Us Today

Ready to start your next Minecraft adventure?

**Server IP:** `simpmc.org`
**Documentation:** [https://doc.simpmc.org](https://doc.simpmc.org)

See you on **SimpMC**!
